data.name: Boarding Strike
data.effect: Make a Strike. You may Stride into the target's zone as part of it, without provoking. On a critical hit the target is knocked Prone.

data.name: Cleaving Blow
data.effect: One Strike against every enemy in your zone, each at -2. Roll damage once and apply it to all.

data.name: Hull Breaker
data.effect: A Strike that treats your weapon as one grade higher against the damage gate, and deals full damage to structures and vessels. On a hit the target is Off-Guard until your next turn.

data.name: Broadside
data.effect: One Strike against every enemy in Engaged and Near. Any critical hit also knocks its target Prone.

data.name: Titan's Wrath
data.effect: For one minute your Strikes gain one extra weapon die, and any enemy that ends its turn in your zone takes damage equal to your ability modifier x your RGM.

data.name: Shipbreaker
data.effect: One Strike against a structure, vessel, or creature of Elite role or larger. It deals maximum damage, and a vessel takes a permanent breach that a Forge profession must repair.

data.name: Annihilation
data.effect: One Strike. If it would reduce the target below half its maximum hit points, the target dies instead. Bosses are immune, but become Slowed 2 until the end of their next turn.

data.name: Knife in the Dark
data.effect: A Strike with one extra weapon die against a target that is Off-Guard, Hidden from, or unaware of you.

data.name: Silent Step
data.effect: Stride and Hide as a single action. The Stride does not provoke and leaves no trace anyone below your grade can follow.

data.name: Killing Angle
data.effect: A Strike. On a critical hit the target gains Persistent Damage equal to your Combat EL.

data.name: Brume Step
data.effect: Step into the brume and out again anywhere within Far. You arrive Hidden. In an uncharted region the range extends to Distant.

data.name: Undertow Body
data.effect: For one minute you are Concealed at all times: attacks against you have disadvantage, and you may Step once per round as a free action.

data.name: Unseen Death
data.effect: A Strike made from Hidden. On a hit the target cannot act until the end of its next turn. On a critical hit it does not register that it was struck at all.

data.name: Absence
data.effect: Remove yourself from the scene for up to one minute. You cannot act and cannot be acted upon. You return anywhere you choose within the region.

data.name: Channel Faith
data.effect: Restore (1d8 + your Combat EL) x your RGM hit points to a creature in Engaged or Near. This also stabilises a Dying creature at Dying 0.

data.name: Sacred Rite
data.effect: Allies in Near gain +1 to attacks and saving throws for one minute. Rites do not stack.

data.name: Smite the Unmade
data.effect: Add two weapon dice to a Strike against anything unfixed, undead, or of a grade above the region's.

data.name: Aegis of the Making
data.effect: An ally in Near gains temporary hit points equal to your Combat EL x RGM, and immunity to one named condition, for one minute.

data.name: Judgement
data.effect: One creature in Far attempts a Will save. On a failure it is Frightened 3 and cannot target you. On a critical failure it must spend its next turn withdrawing.

data.name: Word of Making
data.effect: An ally who died this scene returns at 1 hit point with Wounded 2. Once per long rest.

data.name: Apotheosis
data.effect: For one minute you count as one grade higher for every purpose: the damage gate, resistances, your DCs and your saves. Afterwards you are Drained 2 and cannot bind Possibility until you rest fully.

data.name: Sea Sense
data.effect: Learn the weather, current and depth for the coming watch. The party's next Navigate check gains +2.

data.name: Beast Bond
data.effect: A beast of your grade or lower follows one reasonable instruction. In combat it acts as a Minion under your control until the encounter ends.

data.name: Tide Form
data.effect: Take a sea-beast form for ten minutes. Gain a swim Speed equal to your Speed, +2 AC, and unarmed Strikes that use your normal weapon dice.

data.name: Wild Surge
data.effect: Water in Near erupts. Every enemy there attempts a Reflex save, taking your Combat EL x RGM damage and falling Prone on a failure.

data.name: Turn of the Season
data.effect: Change the weather across the whole region for one watch. Storms break; calm ends. Travel speed for that watch is doubled or halved as you choose.

data.name: Living Storm
data.effect: For one minute you are a storm. Enemies in Near are Slowed 1 and take your Combat EL damage each round. Ranged attacks against you automatically fail.

data.name: Voice of the Deep
data.effect: Call something enormous. It arrives within a watch and will do one thing for you. It will remember having been asked.

data.name: Charge Tap
data.effect: Regain 2 points of attunement, or give 2 to an ally in Engaged. Once per encounter.

data.name: Charge Shaping
data.effect: Change the damage type of your next spell or technique and extend its range by one zone.

data.name: Sigil Focus
data.effect: Inscribe a sigil in your zone for one minute. Allies within it gain +2 to saves; enemies entering take your Combat EL in damage, once each.

data.name: Overcharge
data.effect: Cast one spell or technique at a tier one above your Highest Tier. You are Drained 1 until you next rest fully.

data.name: Charge Sovereignty
data.effect: For one minute every spell and technique you use costs one point fewer, to a minimum of one.

data.name: Reality Edit
data.effect: Reroll any single d20 in the current scene, including one already resolved. The first result did not happen.

data.name: Authorship
data.effect: Declare one fact about this region that could plausibly be true. It is true, and was always true. Once per grade.

data.name: Fathom Whisper
data.effect: Ask one question of a creature in Near. It answers truthfully unless it succeeds a Will save, and it does not remember being asked.

data.name: Binding Pact
data.effect: Strike a bargain. Both parties are bound; whoever breaks it takes Drained 2 and Frightened 2 for a full day, wherever they are.

data.name: Curse Weave
data.effect: One creature in Far takes -2 on one chosen roll type for an hour. On a critical failure the penalty lasts until removed.

data.name: Fate Thread
data.effect: Declare a roll before it is made. Its result counts as one degree worse for an enemy, or one degree better for an ally.

data.name: Mind's Dominion
data.effect: One creature of Standard role or lower in Far obeys you for one minute. Elites attempt a Will save at the end of each of their turns.

data.name: Doom Spoken
data.effect: Name a creature and name a condition. If that condition occurs within a day, the creature drops to Dying 1 wherever it stands.

data.name: Unmaking
data.effect: One creature or object in Far is struck from the record. Written references decay; those who knew it must save to recall it. Once per grade.

data.name: Sound Repair
data.effect: Restore a damaged item to working order, removing one grade of degradation. No roll required.

data.name: Fine Temper
data.effect: A weapon or suit of armour gains +1 to attack or AC for a week. Does not stack with itself.

data.name: Masterwork
data.effect: Raise an item one grade permanently, up to your own profession grade. Consumes materials of the new grade.

data.name: Living Alloy
data.effect: An item repairs itself between rests and cannot be sundered by anything below your grade.

data.name: Everforge
data.effect: Craft two items in the time one would take, or one item at half its material cost.

data.name: Demiforge
data.effect: Create an item of your grade carrying one signature property of your choosing.

data.name: World-Anvil
data.effect: Create an artifact. It has a name, a will of its own, and it will outlast you.

data.name: Field Dressing
data.effect: Restore (1d8 + your Craft EL) x your RGM hit points to a creature in Engaged, and stabilise a Dying creature at Dying 0.

data.name: Tonic Craft
data.effect: Brew (Craft EL / 5, minimum 1) doses. Each restores (2d8 + Craft EL) x RGM and keeps for a week. THIS is how healing keeps pace at high grade — bought potions do not.

data.name: Grafting
data.effect: Replace a lost limb or organ. Removes all Drained and Wounded conditions from the patient.

data.name: Vital Rewrite
data.effect: Remove one disease, poison, curse or persistent condition of your grade or below.

data.name: Rebirth
data.effect: Restore a creature dead less than a day. It returns at half hit points with Wounded 3.

data.name: Panacea
data.effect: Every ally in Near is restored to full hit points and loses every condition. Once per long rest.

data.name: Genesis
data.effect: Make a living thing that has never existed before. It breeds true.

data.name: Dead Reckoning
data.effect: Succeed at this watch's Navigate check automatically, with no roll and no chance of getting lost.

data.name: True North
data.effect: You know your exact position and bearing for a day, even in heavy brume, even where instruments stop.

data.name: Chart the Unknown
data.effect: Chart a region in a single watch rather than a full survey. It counts as a full Discovery, and the region becomes Charted.

data.name: Brume Mapping
data.effect: Map a region you have not entered, from up to two cells away. The result is Sighted, never Charted.

data.name: Fold Distance
data.effect: For a full day the party covers double legs per watch, whatever their transport.

data.name: Realm Gate
data.effect: Open a passage between two regions you have personally Charted. It holds for one watch.

data.name: Axis Point
data.effect: Fix a permanent gate between two Charted regions. It appears on every chart thereafter, and every power in the sea will want it, or want it closed.

data.name: Haggle
data.effect: Buy at 20% below listed price or sell at 20% above. Once per settlement per visit.

data.name: Supply Line
data.effect: The Supply die does not step down at all for the party's next full journey.

data.name: Market Read
data.effect: Learn what a settlement needs, fears, and is concealing about its trade. +4 on social checks there for a day.

data.name: Monopoly
data.effect: Corner one commodity in one settlement. Your downtime income there doubles while it holds.

data.name: Trade Empire
data.effect: Establish a standing route. It pays your downtime income whether you work it or not.

data.name: Economic Fiat
data.effect: Set the price of one commodity across an entire ring. The Compact will find out who did it.

data.name: Value Itself
data.effect: Declare what a thing is worth. It is worth that, everywhere, until something stronger disagrees.

data.name: Copy Exact
data.effect: Reproduce any document perfectly, including a Bench seal. Doing so is forgery and is prosecuted as such in Compact waters.

data.name: Perfect Recall
data.effect: You remember everything you have read or been told. Ask the GM one factual question about the history of the current scene.

data.name: Sigil Literacy
data.effect: Read any script, sigil or chart of your grade or below, including ones no living person can read.

data.name: Forbidden Index
data.effect: Learn one true fact about any named creature, object or place: its grade, and one weakness.

data.name: Total Archive
data.effect: Reconstruct a lost work from fragments. Counts as a full Discovery.

data.name: The Unwritten Read
data.effect: Read a region's history directly out of its brume. You learn why it holds the grade it holds.

data.name: The Record
data.effect: Write something into the record permanently. It becomes historically true, and always was.

data.name: Sound Mechanism
data.effect: Repair or disable any mechanism, lock or trap of your grade or below without a roll.

data.name: Clockwork Aid
data.effect: Build a device granting +2 on one named skill for a week. One per person.

data.name: Autonomous Device
data.effect: Build a construct that fights as a Minion of your grade. It runs for a week on stored charge.

data.name: Bound Construct
data.effect: Build a construct that fights as a Standard of your grade. Permanent while maintained.

data.name: Skyworks
data.effect: Build or refit a vessel of your grade or below, including airships. Halves the purchase price.

data.name: Self-Making
data.effect: Your construct becomes capable of building. It works while you sleep, and it does not stop.

data.name: Prime Mover
data.effect: Build an engine that needs no charge at all. Every power in the sea will want it, or want it destroyed, and most will want both.
